status: not-run as a set. Nothing here is a measured misroute rate.
use: Copy `cases` into a westack-eval routing campaign (kind routing) and register it before any description is tuned. Score the held-out cases once per description version.
population_needed: westack-retro, westack-review, westack-perf and westack-health from this repository. The user's real population also holds standup and stakeholder-update skills from installed plugins (engineering standup, product-management stakeholder-update); keep them in.

cases.prompt: Run a retro on the last week of commits in this repo.
How did this sprint compare to the last one? Use the git history.
What did I work on across all my projects this week?
Give the team a 30-day retrospective: what shipped, hotspots, who did what.
Review the diff on this branch before I merge.
Did last week's changes make the build slower? Measure it.
Score the codebase's health: type errors, lint and test pass rate.
cases.near_miss_of: westack-retro (tool scores now, not a window of work)
